summary: Comprehensive testing of multi-image upload + customer gallery feature. All 12 backend tests pass (auth, MIME validation, 5MB limit, multi-file upload, public file serve, product images normalization with primary mirroring, legacy backward compat, seed backfill). Frontend: admin MultiImageUploader fully functional (drag/click upload, thumbnails, set primary, remove, max-5 enforcement); customer ImageGallery on product detail page shows prev/next arrows, thumbnails, smooth switching; ProductQuickView shows compact gallery with all 3 thumbs and Buy Now button. Legacy single-image products still render cleanly. Fixed one minor backend issue.

minor.issue: Original implementation did not set `images: []` for products without a legacy `image` (left field missing entirely, breaking API contract). FIXED by testing agent: now sets empty array when no legacy image.

issues: Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' (a11y nit, not blocking)
Console warning: 'An empty string ("") was passed to the %s attribute' — likely product with empty image src being rendered (would be fixed once all products have a primary image or fallback)

action_items: (Optional) Provide a fallback placeholder image for products with no image to silence the empty-src React warning.
(Optional a11y) Add aria-describedby or DialogDescription to admin product modal.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend admin/upload sets a 10-file limit per request but the frontend MAX_IMAGES is 5 — consistent within UI but the server allows 10 in a single request (could be tightened to 5 for symmetry).
ImageGallery uses img.url directly assuming it has been pre-resolved by getProductImages — verified correct (helper resolves before passing).
_normalize_product_images correctly enforces a single primary and mirrors it to the legacy `image` field; legacy products with only `image` are auto-converted on read/write.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily created prod-c5e871e8 (TEST_MultiImage Demo with 3 images) for gallery testing — cleaned up. Also cleaned a leftover orphan product prod-1e507eee from previous iterations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-image upload + gallery feature is fully working end-to-end (admin upload via Emergent Object Storage, primary mirroring, legacy backward compat, customer gallery with carousel + thumbs). Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_multi_image_upload.py. The orphan product without an image is cleaned. Customer auth (OTP/email) issues from iteration_6 were NOT re-tested in this iteration — those are out of scope for the current upload feature.
rca_of_the_issue: Minor: `backfill_product_images()` skipped products without legacy `image` field, leaving them missing the `images` key entirely. Fix: always set `images: []` when no legacy image. This ensures consistent API contract for all clients.
